0022600129.text: The Detroit Pistons head to New York for their fourth game of the 2026-27 season, arriving at 3-0 (1-0 at home, 2-0 on the road) and first in the Central and the East, while the Knicks are 0-3, sitting 4th in the Atlantic and 2.5 games back, and 12th in the East. Detroit is missing Ausar Thompson (out, ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision, while New York is without Jose Alvarado (out, ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won all three games against the Knicks in 2025-26, most recently a 126-111 win in New York on February 19, 2026.
